title: Nexora Agreement
description: Machine-readable model for a governed Nexora Agreement (PROP.5). Consumes the PROP.4 Agreement Handoff (only from a CLIENT_ACCEPTED, fingerprint-verified Proposal). An Agreement is NOT a Proposal and NOT a contract: this model records the governed commercial inheritance, provenance, legal-decision classification, document control and execution placeholders. READY_FOR_EXECUTION requires every mandatory legal/commercial decision to be resolved through an approved source; SIGNED/executed state is NOT modelled (e-signature / execution are separate external gates). Authoritative pricing is never stored independently here — the commercial_schedule is inherited verbatim from the accepted Proposal/Handoff and re-validated against ops/billing-source-of-truth.json. VAT is UNDETERMINED and must never be asserted.

agreement_id.description: Agreement lineage identifier, e.g. AGR-2026-9104 (traceable to the source Proposal PRP-2026-9104) or the sequential AGR-YYYY-NNNN form. Not a commercial change.

version.description: Agreement document version (x.y). A revision is a new version, never a silent mutation.

status.description: DRAFT = may contain unresolved LEGAL_DECISION_REQUIRED provisions, clearly labelled NOT FOR EXECUTION. READY_FOR_EXECUTION = every mandatory legal/commercial decision resolved through an approved source and all integrity checks pass. SIGNED is NOT modelled — execution/signature is a separate external gate.

proposal.description: The accepted Proposal this Agreement is derived from.

proposal_fingerprint.description: Canonical SHA-256 (nexora-proposal-canonical/v1) of the accepted Proposal content, carried from the acceptance record / handoff.

acceptance_record.description: Schema id of the acceptance record, e.g. nexora-proposal-acceptance/v1.

agreement_handoff.description: Schema id of the Agreement handoff, e.g. nexora-agreement-handoff/v1.

handoff_fingerprint.description: Canonical SHA-256 of the Agreement handoff content (audit reference).

commercial_schedule.description: Inherited VERBATIM from the accepted Proposal / Agreement Handoff. Approved Final Project Price is the contractual commercial amount; reference/public price is informational only and never replaces it. Re-validated against ops/billing-source-of-truth.json.

reference_price.description: PUBLIC / BASE REFERENCE price (From or fixed) — informational, NOT the contractual amount. Absent for COMPLETE and AI.

approved_final_project_price.description: APPROVED FINAL PROJECT PRICE — the contractual commercial amount, inherited from the accepted Proposal. Governs milestone amounts and invoicing.

payment_schedule.description: Milestone percentages (frozen for standard packages; B3 per-proposal; COMPLETE 30/30/30/10). Milestone amounts derive from the Approved Final Project Price.

recurring_fees.description: AI recurring starts at GO_LIVE, never before. Care is paid monthly in advance.

care.description: Optional Care, monthly in advance, separately identifiable, never bundled. No AI Care.

warranty.description: The only supported warranty claim is the governed 90-day Web Launch Warranty.

status.description: RESOLVED only when classification is not LEGAL_DECISION_REQUIRED in the approved register.

legal_sections.description: One entry per legal clause in the inventory. LEGAL_DECISION_REQUIRED entries render as clearly-marked unresolved provisions in a DRAFT and block READY_FOR_EXECUTION.

execution.description: Execution placeholders ONLY. Not a signature, not an e-signature, not evidence of execution. Must remain null; SIGNED is not modelled (external gate).

_example.description: Fixture marker. MUST be true on any committed example/instance so a real Agreement is never committed by mistake.
